info.title: Swarm Universal API
info.description: The Swarm is a relationship intelligence platform for searching professional profiles and companies, fetching detailed records, and finding warm introductions through your team's network.

get.description: Retrieves companies from Swarm by company ID.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields[]
parameters.description: Optional response fields such as company_info or tags. Provide a JSON array when needed.

schema.description: Optional response fields such as company_info or tags. Provide a JSON array when needed.

parameters.name: ids[]
parameters.description: One or more Swarm company IDs to fetch. Provide a JSON array of IDs or add values in the UI.

schema.description: One or more Swarm company IDs to fetch. Provide a JSON array of IDs or add values in the UI.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

results.description: Fetched company records keyed by requested fields.
